summary: The saved plan is fully implemented: profiles can declare env, GitHub, host-file/local-file, and local-auth leases; unsafe broad or writable auth exposure is rejected or warned with structured reasons; workspace compose specs use read-only declared lease mounts and placeholder env values while preserving legacy compatibility for providers that still need isolated writable auth copies. Provisioner lease issue/mount/revoke metadata is sanitized, worker wiring and docs are updated, and focused tests, ruff, mypy, full unit tests, and 99% coverage all pass.
